item: Row D: the measured OSM ingest as one command; row C S4: the place gazetteer build script and the loader reading it beside the world file
key_paths: scripts/osm_reference_run.py; src/osm/reference_run.py; scripts/build_place_gazetteer.py; src/entities/gazetteer_build.py; src/catalog/cities.py; src/entities/places.py; tests/test_osm_reference_run.py; tests/test_gazetteer_build.py; tests/fixtures/wikidata/place_items.json; docs/SECURITY.md; docs/product/RELEASE_0.5_GATE.md
summary: Tooling for the two 0.5 operator steps, fixture-verified, nothing measured on the reference VM. The runner: a throwaway encrypted store, child processes under a sampler, one JSON report with no secret and no foreign path, a preflight floor (a labelled guess until a measured report replaces it), a mid-run stop below a disk or memory reserve, its store deleted last with the deletion recorded, no download flag. The gazetteer build: OSM place=* + Wikidata wbgetentities (P1082 preferred rank else latest P585, OSM population kept beside it), --plan prints the QID count and the minimum run time, --online refuses unless the transport is named (or --clearnet), output configs/places_gazetteer.yml read beside cities.yml and merged by QID. No migration. Real run times, peak memory, disk and the artifact's sha256 stay the operator's.
